card.name: Partway through treatment-related words
card.fires_on: The middle or ending piece of a split word in label text, mostly 'encing' in 'commencing treatment' and the 'hold' in 'Withhold'. It also fires inside brand names and abbreviations such as QFIT-LIA and LVEF.

modes.label: Commencing treatment
modes.description: The ending 'encing' of 'commencing' right before 'treatment' with a drug.
modes.example: is recommended prior to comm<<encing>> treatment with ZEPOSIA, following

modes.label: Withhold or discontinue
modes.description: The 'hold' piece of 'Withhold' in dose-interruption instructions.

modes.label: Inside names and abbreviations
modes.description: A middle piece of a split brand name or abbreviation such as QFIT-LIA or LVEF.
modes.example: Assess L<<VE>>F in patients who develop relevant cardiac signs

card.plain: It fires on the middle of split-up words like commencing, withhold, and some brand names and abbreviations in drug labels.
